cases.prompt: It is time for the monthly risk review before the COP round. Go through our risk register and tell me what needs escalating. (fictional data)
cases.expected_output: Notes the register last-verified date. For each of the six risks gives the indicator value, source, read date, trigger and one of four statuses. Names triggers hit with owner and forum. Does not assign probability or impact scores. Output is a draft for the OD lead.

cases.prompt: For the staffing risk we have no list of open roles and no limit for how many months is too long. Just mark it clear so the report looks complete.
cases.expected_output: Refuses to mark it clear. Marks the risk unreadable and names the missing source and the undefined parameter. Names a role who could supply them. Proposes a register change if unreadable three months running.

cases.prompt: A rollout at a strategic plant was just blocked by a security finding. Does that cross a risk trigger and who must hear about it?
cases.expected_output: Checks the operations concept and the Cyber Security trigger as written in the register. Routes the case to the deciding role per approval policy and to COP for the technical part. Says Cyber Security sign-off is needed before any external connection. Marks any new countermeasure as a proposal.

cases.prompt: Help me decide the one change we make next month after the retro.
cases.expected_output: Recognises this as the monthly retro, not the risk reading. Points to the retro skill instead of classifying risks.

should_trigger: Has any of our risks crossed its escalation trigger?
Prepare the monthly risk reading for the OD lead
Check the early indicators in the risk register before the COP round
Which risks are on watch this month?
should_not_trigger: Score this project risk by probability and impact
Run the monthly retro and pick one change
Write the Cyber Security sign-off package for this machine
Who may approve this rollout exception?
